text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-controlled Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's cash-strapped state news agency ZIANA must streamline its operations, cut some jobs, introduce a formal marketing policy and ensure effective general cost-management, a report recently commissioned by the agency and funded by the British Council and the British Overseas Development Agency says. It says the agency is under-funded, but is also the victim of poor management and "an endemic culture of non-profit-making".

- Zimbabwe's state National Social Security Authority will from next month introduce a computerised billing system, and hopes it will be able to improve contribution collections, detect debts quickly and also ensure claims are processed faster.
